intents.title: Goal Gravity + Experiential Intelligence + Asymmetry Production Line
intents.statement: A persistent personal advancement intelligence whose standing job is to continuously reduce the distance between Alfonso's current reality and his chosen future states. An authorized persistent goal acts as an attractor for relevant perception, reasoning, preparation, capability formation and action. Build the mechanism, not the mythology.
intents.source: Founder directive, Claude Code cloud session session_01KQmkR1TJHFHxAYCTehiLqC (chat text is lineage, not founder authentication)
intents.intended_outcome: Authorized goals persist across restarts, sleep at zero cost, wake from relevant evidence, favorable intersections or cadence; the active gate and single bottleneck metric are computed from provenance-backed evidence; permitted low-risk moves execute only through the Consequence Gate under pre-existing grants; everything else is prepared; founder decisions are compressed, deduplicated and rare; verified outcomes leave durable assets that make later goals measurably cheaper; no new authority is created and no consciousness is claimed.
affected_systems: uniimente-kernel egregore/ (standing cognition runtime extended with the Goal Gravity loop)
DALEOBANKS and WealthMachineIntelligence as sensor and assessment sources through existing adapters (no change in this record)
intents.rationale: The directive is an explicit clarification of the intended GREG operating behavior with literal implementation targets and acceptance tests. Repository truth on main carried none of targets A-I; unmerged draft lineages carry overlapping mechanisms that await founder merge decisions. Extending the canonical runtime on main with ledger-backed goal structures composes the existing Gate, ledger, policy engine and genome registry without creating a parallel plane, and leaves the drafts' mechanisms preserved and credited for reconciliation.

intents.binding_scope: uniimente-kernel canonical runtime (`egregore/`); organs consume through existing adapters/contracts; the dated id avoids the numeric `INTENT-00NN` series that is contended across unmerged branches (0029–0037 allocated in drafts)
intents.constitutional_constraints: CAPABILITY GROWTH != AUTHORITY GROWTH; the Kernel Consequence Gate remains the only path to external effect; no second Kernel, mission system, identity system, authority root, evidence plane or competing GREG; goals are declared lineage, never authentication; Alfonso retains stop/change/lower/never-tactic/mute/ask-before/forget/revoke; no claim of consciousness; "meniscus", "impermeable shield" and "systemic dominance" compile to the strongest defensible operating frontier inside a verified permission/rights/safety/resource/evidence envelope, layered prevention and recovery, and superior lawful capability respectively; none licenses control over people, resistance to shutdown or promises of perfection
intents.success_evidence: `tests/unit/test_goal_gravity.py` (the fourteen section-25 scenarios plus boundary tests); `tests/integration/test_goal_gravity_acceptance.py` (section-33 chain); `goal_gravity_closures()` green on the integration registry; `contracts/goal-record.schema.json`, `contracts/goal-state.schema.json`, `contracts/experience-event.schema.json` and `contracts/capability-deficit.schema.json` are enforced on every write by `egregore.contract_check` (JSON Schema 2020-12 with fail-closed format checking); they are deliberately outside the pinned boundary-package allowlist in `adapters/contract_validation.py`. `tests/unit/test_goal_gravity_seams.py` covers the standing-cognition seam, deficit classes, reconciliation, independent outcome verification and the section-20 controls. Evidence tier: IMPLEMENTED / UNIT-TESTED / INTEGRATION-TESTED on synthetic ledgers with test-minted grants; not SANDBOX-VERIFIED, not EXTERNALLY VERIFIED, not FOUNDER-ACCEPTED
intents.failure_evidence: A goal that executes without a pre-existing grant; a route re-proposed unchanged after a founder refusal; a duplicate consequential action after restart; a contradiction silently collapsed; an ask without a no-cost option; any claim that "GREG experiences reality" or "creates coincidences" resting on this code alone
